title: gameProject
responsibility: Extend an app plan with the runtime, document and authoring files for a 2d or 3d game.

inputs.name: gameFiles.input
inputs.description: Project input with optional game dimension; defaults to 2d and supports 3d.

inputs.name: gameFiles.app
inputs.description: Valid app file plan containing package, formatter and Vite configuration. Those entries are updated in place before game files are appended.

outputs.name: gameFiles
outputs.description: App and game file plan with bundled engine source, game.json, a playable route and authoring guidance. Normal checks preserve static qualification and refuse unreviewed screenshot baselines.
